changes.title: Spell glow stronger
items: Creatures' spells glow more strongly: brighter cores, wider halos and more of their light on the ground, each still in its own element's colour

changes.title: Rulings 1116
items: Legends hit creatures much harder: 50 a hit, not 10, whether they lob, beam or charge
You can always take off from the treehouse, even with adults or legends following you

changes.title: Haunted hush
items: The hush before the drum & bass drop in the quiet, haunted part of the music now lasts 8 bars, not 4

changes.title: Home legends
items: A friendly legend that has walked the route and come home now guards exactly like the island's own home legend: it stands where the home legend stands (a spot of its own beside it) and fights what comes into its reach, rather than rushing to defend you first

Home legends can become party legends: the island's home legend and a legend back from the route both take letters, and the 100th gives it the giant party hat; pick up its sigil and you are on its short leash, put the sigil down and it goes back to guarding home
A home-guarding legend put back at its post now stops there instead of keeping its run

changes.title: Ouch
items: Her "ouch!" is back: she cries out when a hit lands on her, as she did until early October, with the music dipping under it
